resources.string: Your phone and your Mac, working together on your own network: clipboard, files, notifications, calls and more.
Turns on the essentials: pairing with your Mac, the clipboard when you tap Send, and your phone\'s notifications on your Mac. Turn on more any time in Settings.
Pick what you want, answer a few short questions, and turn on anything else from one list.
Pair once, and from then on your phone and Mac find each other on this network.
Nothing reaches a Mac until you pair one.
Looking for Macs on this network. Open Bridgey on the Mac.
Bridgey is ready. Change anything later in Settings.
Skipped for now: %1$s. Settings, Privacy, Permissions still offers them.
Go through setup from the start. Pairings and settings are kept.
Shows your phone\'s notifications and calls on your Mac.
No phone notifications, call alerts or codes on the Mac.
Lets Bridgey show transfers, find-my-phone, call prompts and screen sharing.
You will not see progress, requests from the Mac, or the Stop button for Find Device and screen sharing.
Lets the Mac answer, decline and place calls through this phone. With Text messages on a dual-SIM phone, lists the SIMs.
Calls from the Mac open the dialer for you to confirm; Answer and Decline do not work.
Shows your recent photos and videos when you send files, lets your Macs browse them, and sends a screenshot you just took with \"Send copied item\".
The Photos and videos tab and your Macs see no photos, and \"Send a fresh screenshot\" stays off.
Takes a photo when a Mac asks for one, after you unlock the phone and tap.
Take Photo on the Mac shows that the camera is not allowed.
Android 15 and later hide one-time codes from apps that are not linked to a nearby device.
Lets Bridgey see who sent a text, so replies go to the right conversation.
Codes from messages show \"hidden\" on the Mac.
Turns on Do Not Disturb here while a Mac is in Focus, when Follow the Mac\'s Focus is on.
The phone does not follow the Mac\'s Focus.
Keeps Bridgey connected while the phone sleeps.
The connection drops in the background and reconnects late.
Updates download but you install them by hand.
Text messages: shows your conversations on your Mac and sends the texts you write there.
Text messages stays off. Codes from messages still work.
Background clipboard (advanced) reads the clipboard while Bridgey is in the background.
Copying on the phone sends only while Bridgey is open, or with one tap.
What Bridgey may use, and why
Bridgey asks for a permission only when a feature needs it. Manage opens the matching Android screen.
Delete activity, caches, settings or everything
Choose what to delete. Each choice lists exactly what goes and what stays. Your Macs keep their own data.
Activity, notification history, diagnostics and transfer history. Keeps settings and pairings.
Downloaded updates, the clipboard cache and folder journals. Keeps settings, pairings and history.
Every setting back to its default, and setup runs again. Keeps pairings, history and caches.
All of the above, plus trusted devices and this phone\'s identity. Pair your Macs again afterwards.
Bridgey disconnects, restarts and opens first-run setup. Paired devices will need pairing again.
Diagnostics events, including the remote control audit log and connection health
Folder transfer journals (interrupted folders will not resume)
Each Mac\'s saved list of Mac actions (controls, widgets and the Lock tile)
Other caches, including the recent documents index and camera photos waiting to be sent
Feature switches, per-device settings, logging switches, Focus switches and this phone\'s name
Previews, reduced motion, remote control, screenshot, attach sheet and widget choices
Update all records: the last run, automatic update waits and Laters
Setup is new. Review it to see every feature and choose how it works; your settings stay as they are.
Bridgey was updated. The release notes list everything that changed.
See what\'s new and review your setup
A new setup, a Permissions page and Reset are in Settings.

- A new first-run setup: get started quickly with sensible defaults, or go through every feature.
- Settings, Privacy, Permissions lists every permission, why Bridgey asks and what stops working without it.
- Settings, Privacy, Reset Bridgey on this device deletes activity, caches, settings or everything.
- Codes from messages shows which Mac the phone is linked to, and lets you choose.
- Phones that stop background apps get their own battery checklist.
- Settings, About can add Bridgey to Obtainium.
This phone stops apps in the background beyond Android\'s own battery settings. Change these once, and check them again after a system update.
Xiaomi, Redmi and Poco (HyperOS and MIUI)
Settings, Apps, Auto launch: turn on Bridgey.
App info, Battery usage: allow background activity.
Battery, Battery optimisation: choose Don\'t optimise for Bridgey. Under Advanced optimisation, turn off Deep optimisation and Sleep standby optimisation.
Settings, App management, Auto launch: turn on Bridgey.
App info, Battery usage: allow background activity.
Battery, More settings, Optimise battery use: choose Don\'t optimise for Bridgey.
App info, Battery saver: choose No restrictions.
Battery optimisation: choose Don\'t optimise. Also lock Bridgey in recent apps.
Battery, Background usage limits: turn off Put unused apps to sleep.
Battery, Background usage limits, Never sleeping apps: add Bridgey, and remove it from Sleeping apps and Deep sleeping apps.
i Manager, App manager, Autostart manager: turn on Bridgey.
Battery, Background power consumption: allow Bridgey.
App info, Battery: choose Don\'t restrict background activity.
Link this phone to which Mac?
Android links the phone to one nearby Mac. Codes then reach every Mac that reads them.
